name: pdf
description: Opens a PDF file into a shared, reference-typed PDF object for reading. The object can be used directly with the Pdf* builtin functions or via method calls (e.g. Pdf( path ).toImage( 1, 400 )). A PDF in RustCFML is read-only: every method is terminal. This function is an alias of pdfRead().

params.name: pathOrBinary
params.description: Absolute path to a PDF file, or a Binary containing the PDF bytes.

examples.title: Open a PDF for reading
examples.description: Create a PDF object from a file path.
